ConversationHistoryItemResponse.title: ConversationHistoryItemResponse

ConversationStreamEvent.description:
The small, public event envelope used by the browser SSE client.

The event type and activity values are intentionally closed sets.  Agent
provider chunks, tool arguments, diagnostics, and hidden reasoning never
cross this boundary.
ConversationStreamEvent.title: ConversationStreamEvent

ConversationTurnResponse.description: One persisted public conversation turn without model/provider data.
ConversationTurnResponse.title: ConversationTurnResponse

ConversationTurnsResponse.description: The saved transcript for one thread owned by the current identity.
ConversationTurnsResponse.title: ConversationTurnsResponse

EmailChallengeRequest.description:
Request an email verification code.

Server-side normalization and validation remain authoritative; the
bounded field prevents oversized bodies from reaching the auth service.
EmailChallengeRequest.title: EmailChallengeRequest

post.description:
Stream a browser-safe lifecycle while retaining JSON compatibility.

The channel service still owns identity resolution, idempotency,
persistence, and answer projection.  This route only wraps that one
execution in a bounded, typed SSE envelope; it never starts a second
Agent task or persistence path.

delete.description: Permanently remove one thread owned by the current web identity.
